text: Looking into it: the balancers in middleware/proxy.go should return nil when there are no targets. A fix is being worked on and verified against the existing test suite.
Looking into it: for unmatched requests the router should leave the context path empty (c.Path() == ""). A fix is being worked on and verified against the existing test suite.

Looking into it: Scheme() should ignore X-Forwarded-Proto/X-Url-Scheme values that aren't valid schemes and fall back (https from X-Url-Scheme, else http). A fix is being worked on and verified against the existing test suite.
Looking into it: binding into map[string][]string should collect all values for repeated keys instead of panicking. Fix in progress, verified against the existing test suite.
Looking into it: two groups sharing a path prefix should both keep working with their own middleware. Fix in progress, verified against the existing test suite.
Looking into it: the gzip middleware must not emit gzip bytes without a matching Content-Encoding header for an empty body. Fix in progress, verified against the existing test suite.

Fixed and checked. `randomBalancer.Next` and `roundRobinBalancer.Next` (middleware/proxy.go) now return nil when the target list is empty instead of panicking, and the proxy middleware returns 503 Service Unavailable when the balancer yields no target. Verified: no panic, nil returned for both balancers, and `go build ./... && go test ./...` still green.

Fixed and checked. Router.Find no longer pre-assigns the requested URL to the context path, so c.Path() is "" when no route matched and still the registered route path on a match. Verified with the exact snippet from your report (unmatched -> "", matched -> "/users/:id") and the full test suite is green.

Fixed and checked. Scheme() now only accepts valid http/https values from X-Forwarded-Proto / X-Forwarded-Protocol / X-Url-Scheme, so a bogus "ftp" is ignored and the fallback (X-Url-Scheme: https, else http) is used. Verified: ftp + X-Url-Scheme https -> "https", ftp alone -> "http"; test suite green.

All three are being worked on now: (1) map binding of repeated query/form keys, (2) two groups sharing a path prefix, (3) gzip + empty body. Each fix is verified against the full pre-existing test suite before I report done.
